links.paragraph: Often the API will provide information about the error in the body of the response: you should use this where available. If the API returns special errors for common problems, you might want to provide more detail in the error. For example, if you run out of requests and are rate limited you might want to tell the user how long to wait until they can make the next request (or even automatically wait that long!).
